caption: The drawing depicts a metallic weather vane with an ornate, symmetrical design mounted on a vertical rod. The weather vane is made of a grayish metal with darker outlines used to define edges and contours. Its main body is rectangular with elaborately curved ends, terminating in scroll-like shapes on both sides and a pointed arrow at one end; the other end is rounded and similarly decorated. The horizontal body of the vane has two internal rectangular sections separated by a raised central rib, and one section contains a cut-out quatrefoil shape. Perpendicular to the horizontal vane, a vertical rod passes through its midpoint, topped by a blue-green finial with a teardrop shape and a rounded base, and a corresponding, slightly larger, and more ornate finial at the bottom. At the upper left corner of the drawing, there is a smaller inset diagram of the weather vane with dimensions written as “5½”” for height and “4’” for width. The entire drawing is set on a light beige or cream background, bordered by red lines.
title: Weather Vane
